facts.fact: Kabum Digital reports that Mozambique's registry and notary service (SRN) launched an online platform, utente.srn.gov.mz, where companies can be registered remotely, with payment by M-Pesa or bank.
Kabum Digital says users of the SRN portal can submit a list of beneficial owners (lista de beneficiários efectivos) as one of the filing actions.

RSM Mozambique says Decree-Law 1/2024 requires legal entities to register their beneficial owners (10 per cent threshold) with the Conservatoria do Registo das Entidades Legais, submitted online at utente.srn.gov.mz and completed in person.

facts.fact: CGA Advogados says Decreto-Lei 1/2024 of 8 March 2024 makes beneficial owner declarations registrable at the Conservatoria do Registo das Entidades Legais, due by 6 June 2024, and that they can now be filed remotely on its submission portal, though final approval on the portal was still being harmonised.

facts.fact: The BAU one-stop business registration centre operates across 129 service points nationwide, per its director-general Daniel Bay.
Per Daniel Bay, the BAU lets firms go from name reservation to obtaining a Tax Identification Number (NUIT) and registering employees with social security at one point.
